name: 15061 · Monaca, PA
findings: ZIP 15061 (Monaca) has 49 nonprofit organizations. 20 of them (41%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 15 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (17% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 15061 (Monaca) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Religious organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 5 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity in their tax returns or on their websites. Many may still offer them without describing them there.

confidence.text: Based on 5 organizations here; 29% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.title: More organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 15061 (Monaca) list volunteering in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.4 times the typical level).
